Report Description
CALLER STATES THAT A MULTI-FAMILY UNIT THAT WAS UNDER CONSTRUCTION HAS EXPLODED FROM AN UNKNOWN CAUSE. THERE WERE 3 CONTRACTORS THAT WERE WORKING AT THE JOB SITE AND ONE WAS INJURED. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT OBSERVED THAT THERE WAS A GAS LEAK THAT WAS CONTRIBUTING TO THE FIRE FROM A 1 INCH PLASTIC SERVICE LINE. BEFORE THE EXPLOSION, A CONTRACTOR WAS PERFORMING WELDING ON A WATER SERVICE LINE WHICH WAS OCCURRING 8 INCHES FROM THE GAS LINE. AN EXPLOSION THEN OCCURRED 3 FEET FROM THE FACE OF THE BUILDING. AT 1615 PG&E RESPONDED. POLICE, FIRE AND MEDIA ARE ON SCENE. DAMAGES ARE ABOVE 50K. THE FLOW OF GAS WAS STOPPED AT 1750 BY SQUEEZING AT THE SERVICE TEE. IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE GAS LEAK BEGAN BEFORE OR AFTER THE EXPLOSION.
